synopses.zh: 医疗快递员布莱恩陷入一个混乱不断升级的夜晚，必须为生存而战。扎克·克雷格执导的这部影片，讲述了《生化危机》世界中的一个新故事。
synopses.en: Medical courier Bryan finds himself caught in a night of escalating chaos and must fight to survive. Directed by Zach Cregger, this is a new story in the Resident Evil universe.

Resident Evil (2026).source_synopsis: Medical courier Bryan finds himself caught in a night of escalating chaos and must fight to survive. Directed by Zach Cregger, this is a new story in the Resident Evil universe.

synopses.zh: 影片讲述登山家丹增·诺尔盖与埃德蒙·希拉里共同登顶珠穆朗玛峰的非凡旅程，展现这次历史性攀登背后的决心与合作。
synopses.en: The story of mountaineer Tenzing Norgay and his extraordinary journey to the summit of Everest alongside Edmund Hillary, exploring the determination and partnership behind their historic ascent.

Tenzing.source_synopsis: The story of mountaineer Tenzing Norgay and his extraordinary journey to the summit of Everest alongside Edmund Hillary, exploring the determination and partnership behind their historic ascent.

synopses.zh: 博士生奥利芙与令人望而生畏的教授亚当·卡尔森假扮情侣。随着这段约定越来越复杂，她发现真实的感情并不遵循严谨的假说。
synopses.en: PhD candidate Olive enters a pretend relationship with intimidating professor Adam Carlsen. As their arrangement grows more complicated, the scientist discovers that real feelings do not follow a neat hypothesis.

The Love Hypothesis.source_synopsis: PhD candidate Olive enters a pretend relationship with intimidating professor Adam Carlsen. As their arrangement grows more complicated, the scientist discovers that real feelings do not follow a neat hypothesis.

synopses.zh: 《牛来》（2026）是一部中国普通话动画长片，由辛宇萌执导、孙丽芳编剧。
synopses.en: Niu Lai (2026) is a Mandarin-language animated feature from China, directed by Xin Yumeng and written by Sun Lifang.

牛来 (Niu Lai).source_synopsis: Niu Lai (2026) is a Mandarin-language animated feature from China, directed by Xin Yumeng and written by Sun Lifang.

synopses.zh: 入狱的银行家安迪·杜弗雷恩与狱友瑞德建立了长久的友谊。在肖申克度过的岁月里，他们的故事探讨了坚持、尊严与希望的力量。
synopses.en: Imprisoned banker Andy Dufresne forms a lasting friendship with fellow inmate Red. Across years inside Shawshank, their story explores perseverance, dignity and the power of hope.

The Shawshank Redemption.source_synopsis: Imprisoned banker Andy Dufresne forms a lasting friendship with fellow inmate Red. Across years inside Shawshank, their story explores perseverance, dignity and the power of hope.
